rationale: GMAB has surged roughly 32% today on massive relative volume (9x normal) with no news context available, suggesting a likely catalyst-driven gap that has already run most of its range (price at 94.5% of today's range). The last five 1-minute candles show clear distribution — consecutive lower closes from ~$59.85 down to $59.15 with declining volume on bounces — but with 77 minutes to close, the stock is extended far above VWAP ($54.91) and the 9-EMA is rolling over ($59.27 vs last $59.12), making both a long chase and a short against an unknown catalyst equally dangerous. Without understanding the fundamental driver, the risk/reward on either side is unfavorable.
